activation_state.finding: The defect was not VIT activation. It was incomplete mechanical enforcement of VIT lineage at downstream packet/branch/PR/SIQ candidate-admission surfaces.

write_capable_or_candidate_surfaces_foun: external Git branch / GitHub PR actuator

entrypoint_findings.pre_correction: Eligible packets could receive ALLOW_VIT_GENERAL_SERIALIZED_GATEWAY using authority/prerequisite/QA fields without proving PIP, VIT generation or placement lineage.
entrypoint_findings.correction: Require canonical PIP/generation/placement IDs before general admission.

entrypoint_findings.pre_correction: The still-active narrow pilot authority path could admit an otherwise-green low-risk packet without VIT lineage IDs.
entrypoint_findings.correction: Require PIP/generation/placement IDs on the active pilot path too.

entrypoint_findings.pre_correction: QueueCandidate could become READY using candidate head/base/QA/authority fields without VIT provenance.
entrypoint_findings.correction: SIQ now validates the full canonical VIT_MANDATORY lineage record, matching packet/PIP/generation/placement IDs, before READY or lease acquisition.

entrypoint_findings.pre_correction: Pull-request assurance could start repository/parity fan-out without proving a permanent PR was derived from a canonical PIP/VIT placement.
entrypoint_findings.correction: Add one early required VIT routing preflight in the existing workflow; it validates inline lineage, exact PR base/head trees and reference-applies the PIP to reproduce the PR head before expensive assurance. No third PR listener is added.

entrypoint_findings.pre_correction: Automatic ORCH selection identified work but did not bind its execution substrate to VIT.
entrypoint_findings.correction: ORCH selection now records DSAI3V VIT as required execution substrate, requires PIP before execution and explicitly denies direct physical-main candidate status.

entrypoint_findings.pre_correction: Branch/PR planning and assisted push surfaces were correctly non-merge-authoritative but did not state that remote branch refs remain non-authoritative until VIT admission.
entrypoint_findings.correction: Bind permanent PR planning / branch push to DSAI3V VIT and require later VIT lineage; direct physical-main candidate remains false.

entrypoint_findings.pre_correction: The active GitHub App receipt-bot transport created a branch and permanent proposal PR directly from frozen current main without PIP/VIT generation/placement proof.
entrypoint_findings.correction: Before remote PR creation the bot now builds an exact IntegrationAuthorityManifest, DependencyFrontier, PacketIntegrationPayload, VIT generation and placement from its frozen target bytes; it verifies the remote branch tree equals the PIP result tree and attaches VIT-Lineage-B64 to the PR.

entrypoint_findings.pre_correction: Abstract/test and historical pre-activation proposal surfaces contain branch/PR adapter shapes but are not the current active production transport and carry no merge authority.
entrypoint_findings.correction: Classified in the coverage register; any new permanent PR produced after this correction must pass the same VIT PR preflight and cannot reach SIQ without full VIT_MANDATORY lineage. Historical pre-activation evidence remains immutable.

entrypoint_findings.surface: external Git branch / GitHub PR actuator
entrypoint_findings.pre_correction: Repository code cannot prevent an external actor from creating a Git ref before VIT admission.
entrypoint_findings.correction: Construction branches remain explicitly non-authoritative under the conformance contract; permanent PR CI fails closed on missing lineage and SIQ independently fails closed. No unsupported root-level guidance file is required for enforcement.

stale_main_case_reproduction.observed: Main advanced through unrelated RCCRI-WP7A while required assurance was running; method-design bytes/hashes were preserved unchanged and no semantic conflict was observed.
Physical main advanced during exact-head assurance and the bounded PS0 payload was reconstructed onto a fresh current-main branch.

Exact-head QA found a real packet-local conformance defect: a research-only candidate registry changed the frozen C2P core registry count from 12 to 13. The successor moved the candidate research record outside the core registry namespace.
RCCR gate evidence and authority classification were unchanged, but an unrelated Path-2 method-freeze main advance caused a fresh current-main gate candidate to be created.

integration_defect_corrections.defect: Root AGENTS.md guidance addition caused GRT A8 shadow NOT_EVALUABLE because the root file is outside the canonical artefact-type mapping.
integration_defect_corrections.resolution: Restore AGENTS.md byte-for-byte to current main and retain enforcement in typed contracts, registries, runtime and required CI surfaces.

historical_support.interpretation: The defect reproduces the stale-main waste class VIT was designed to eliminate; three live correction-time main advances were handled on the same permanent PR lineage with zero payload rebuilds.

required_invariants: Every permanent eligible packet has canonical PIP identity before it becomes a permanent integration candidate.
Every permanent integration candidate is bound to one PIP, VIT generation and VIT placement whose reference apply exactly reproduces its candidate tree.
SIQ cannot READY-admit a candidate without full valid VIT_MANDATORY lineage.
Operator-required packets are represented in VIT and parked; they are not direct-main exceptions.
Unrelated physical-main movement with unchanged PIP/dependency/authority yields PLACEMENT_RECOMPUTE_ONLY and zero payload rebuilds.
Only an identity-bearing payload/dependency defect/change may produce PAYLOAD_REBUILD_REQUIRED.
Existing VIT/SIQ authority and one-head physical serialization remain unchanged.
registered_exception_policy: Only exact, finite bootstrap/recovery exceptions may bypass the early PR-lineage preflight. No exception grants direct SIQ admission or new authority.
rollback: Forward-disable the correction only; preserve VIT active authority, SIQ serialization, all audit records, historical stale-main evidence and Git history.
